verdict.rationale: Caveman is a cloud workspace that stores chats, call logs, spend data and automations, so data export and portability are a fair question to ask. The evidence pack documents no export feature and no open-format download. The open-source CLI working without an account, the call-lookup view and an OpenAPI spec are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not a documented way to export all your data and leave.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
